name: dsx
description: Deterministic guardrails for data science, analytics and BI work, for any coding agent. An ANALYSIS-SPEC contract written before the data is touched, a stdlib-only Python checker with a three-way exit code, fourteen on-demand skills and six adversarial agents. One always-on rule at session start; a Stop hook that refuses to end the session on a failing audit. Also installable as a GSD Core capability.
